sources.title: 2023 AGM notice: director particulars
sources.findings: Sajjan Jindal DIN00017762; born December 5, 1959; first board appointment March 15, 1994; BE Mechanical; early western-region OP Jindal operations.
sources.caution: Read director particulars on last page, not entire annual report. Board appointment is not founding of all JSW businesses; current roles refreshed separately.

sources.title: 2025–26 governance: leadership
sources.findings: Sajjan Jindal chairman and managing director; Jayant Acharya joint managing director and CEO. Group spans steel, energy, infrastructure, cement, paints and mobility.
sources.caution: Read leadership section. Corporate impact/scale claims not independently audited here. Chairman/MD is distinct from CEO.

sources.title: Jury biography
sources.findings: Career began at steel plant in 1982; bachelor of mechanical engineering Bangalore University; JSW Group chairman.
sources.caution: Age and company valuations on undated page not treated as current. Degree-granting institution used; Ramaiah college mentioned by other biographies, not a second degree. Graduation year not established here.

sources.title: 13 October 2021: officers elected
sources.findings: Sajjan Jindal elected chairman for 2021/22 one-year period.
sources.caution: Industry association role, not permanent current chairmanship.

sources.title: 18 October 2022: new officers
sources.findings: Jeong-Woo Choi chairman, Sajjan Jindal vice-chairman for 2022/23.
sources.caution: Historical one-year vice-chair term not asserted as current in 2026.

sources.title: 23 February 2023: Entrepreneur of the Year 2022
sources.findings: India overall award for 2022 announced February 23, 2023; qualified to represent India at world competition.
sources.caution: Award year differs from presentation year; not claim of winning world title. Award announcement text obtained in search; open returned navigation opening.

sources.title: 3 October 2023: JSW Infrastructure trading debut
sources.findings: Group infrastructure business started stock exchange trading October 3, 2023.
sources.caution: Read article opening only; no share-price performance or valuation adopted. Company listing is not personal IPO.

sources.title: 6 January 2026: steel antitrust investigation
sources.findings: Reported investigation findings named JSW and Sajjan Jindal; companies/executives could object before final CCI order. JSW denied allegations to regulator, per sources.
sources.caution: Read report; confidential order not independently inspected. Investigative findings not final ruling or criminal conviction. Targeted follow-up search found no verified final disposition; do not assert proof of absence.

sources.title: 4 November 2026: Jindal meets West Bengal chief minister
sources.findings: Reports same-day Nabanna meeting on industrial expansion and social projects.
sources.caution: Actual reported meeting is recent activity evidence. Planned construction, inauguration and future power generation are not completed outcomes; do not infer launch from discussion.
